body:
## Pull request overview

Updates example app dashboard definitions to comply with the spec change that made `DashboardWidgetSchema.id` (snake_case) mandatory, unblocking schema validation/CI for the example apps.

**Changes:**
- Added a required `id` field to each dashboard widget in the example CRM and TODO apps.
- Ensured widget IDs follow the `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` pattern.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/app-todo/src/dashboards/task.dashboard.ts | Adds `id` to each Task dashboard widget so it passes `DashboardWidgetSchema` validation. |
| examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/service.dashboard.ts | Adds `id` to each Service dashboard widget so it passes `DashboardWidgetSchema` validation. |
| examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/sales.dashboard.ts | Adds `id` to each Sales dashboard widget so it passes `DashboardWidgetSchema` validation. |
| examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/executive.dashboard.ts | Adds `id` to each Executive dashboard widget so it passes `DashboardWidgetSchema` validation. |
